title.en: High quality grooming and coat styling

text.en: Clients consistently praise the standard of grooming, highlighting smooth coat finishes, effective de-matting, and tidy nail clipping. Dog owners note that even challenging coats, such as labradoodle curls, are styled skillfully to suit the dog. Reviewers also appreciate extra services such as thorough teeth cleaning performed during sessions.

Dog owners describe groomer Andrea as warm, helpful, and reassuring from drop-off to collection. Reviewers appreciate her clear advice regarding suitable coat styles and her willingness to accommodate flexible appointment scheduling. Clients frequently express gratitude for her welcoming manner and attentiveness towards first-time visitors.

Pet parents emphasize how comfortable and happy their dogs appear during and after their grooming sessions. Reviewers note that dogs visiting a parlour for the first time are put at ease with patient, gentle care throughout their stay. Owners also highlight that breeds of varying sizes, including sighthounds and doodles, are well managed.

q.en: Does Bow Wow Beauty groom large dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, the salon accommodates dogs of all sizes and breeds, including greyhounds and labradoodles.
Yes, grooming sessions must be booked in advance as the salon operates on an appointment-only schedule.

q.en: Does the salon offer teeth cleaning for dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that dental cleaning and nail clipping are available alongside regular coat grooming.

q.en: How does the groomer handle nervous or first-time pets?

a.en: Clients mention that first-time dogs and anxious pets receive calm, one-to-one attention to ensure a relaxed visit.
